intro: The language model reads and writes messages in Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and English. Every rupee is computed by plain, unit-tested code with a visible formula, so a price can never be hallucinated.

items: Vision model for handwritten rate slips

agents.name: Kharid
agents.job: Sends RFQs, reads replies, computes landed cost and delay risk against the customer's deadline, negotiates price and dates inside limits, raises the PO after approval, tracks delivery.

agents.name: Bhav
agents.job: Tracks benchmarks and the cluster median, flags overpriced quotes, says buy now or wait.

agents.name: Lagat
agents.job: Reads a buyer's drawing, photo or voice spec, checks it against the shop's machines, builds a should-cost, drafts a protected quote, runs Loss Guard.

agents.name: Bazaar
agents.job: Finds and matches new buyer enquiries from GeM, ONDC and lead lists; drafts responses.

agents.name: Sangha
agents.job: Pools demand from neighbouring units for group buys and shared truckloads.

properties.brief: Pursues a goal over many steps
properties.how: Munim turns “2 ton MS sheet by Friday” into a plan: RFQ → collect → compare → negotiate → recommend → PO → track.

properties.brief: Plans and acts in external systems
properties.how: Sends WhatsApp messages, reads replies, queries price benchmarks, checks GeM bids, generates PO documents.
Checkpointed state per case: suppliers, quotes, rounds, the owner's limits and history with each supplier.
Confirms unclear fields, reminds silent suppliers, widens the RFQ, falls back to a second model.
Hard gates on award, PO, quote to a buyer, payment and sharing data with a lender.

guardrails.may: Message suppliers on the owner's list
guardrails.mayNot: Contact anyone outside the approved list without asking
guardrails.control: Approve new suppliers with one tap

guardrails.may: Counter up to 3 rounds inside the floor and ceiling
guardrails.mayNot: Exceed the ceiling, invent a competing offer or reveal a rival's price
guardrails.control: Sets ceiling, rounds and credit terms on the policy card

guardrails.may: Prepare a ranked recommendation and a draft PO
guardrails.mayNot: Award, sign or send a PO

guardrails.may: Draft the quote with a cost breakdown
guardrails.mayNot: Send it, or send anything below the Loss Guard floor
guardrails.control: Approves; overrides Loss Guard only with a logged reason

guardrails.may: Prepare a payment link and remind on due dates
guardrails.control: Pays through their own bank or UPI

guardrails.may: Build an anonymised cluster index from 5+ units
guardrails.mayNot: Share any unit's identity, prices or buyers without consent

safeguards: Every supplier's first message says it is BhavSetu, an assistant acting for the named unit, with an opt-out.
Uncertain prices, units or GST treatment are confirmed with the supplier, never guessed.
The owner can say “ruko” or “stop” at any time to freeze every open case.
Every message, calculation, approval and override is logged with a timestamp.
Only the data each task needs is collected, with consent, in line with the DPDP Act, 2023.

real: Landed-cost, delay-risk, Loss Guard and savings engines in Python and TypeScript
26 tests on one shared set of test vectors, run on every push
Every number in the calculators and simulator on this page, computed live by those engines

Speech and vision confidence scores shown in the trace
